metrics.label: Node Systemd Socket Accepted Connections Total

kibana.query:
TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_systemd_socket_accepted_connections_total IS NOT NULL
| STATS node_systemd_socket_accepted_connections_total = AVG(IRATE(metrics.node_systemd_socket_accepted_connections_total)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.name
| SORT time_bucket ASC

TS metrics-node.prometheus-default
| WHERE (?node == "" OR (labels.instance RLIKE ?node OR (labels.instance IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?node)))
| WHERE (?job == "" OR (labels.job RLIKE ?job OR (labels.job IS NULL AND "" RLIKE ?job)))
| WHERE metrics.node_systemd_units IS NOT NULL
| STATS Activating = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((labels.state == "activating"), metrics.node_systemd_units, NULL), 5m)), Active = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((labels.state == "active"), metrics.node_systemd_units, NULL), 5m)), Deactivating = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((labels.state == "deactivating"), metrics.node_systemd_units, NULL), 5m)), Failed = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((labels.state == "failed"), metrics.node_systemd_units, NULL), 5m)), Inactive = AVG(LAST_OVER_TIME(CASE((labels.state == "inactive"), metrics.node_systemd_units, NULL), 5m)) BY time_bucket = TBUCKET(100, ?_tstart, ?_tend), labels.instance, labels.job
| KEEP time_bucket, `labels.instance`, `labels.job`, Activating, Active, Deactivating, Failed, Inactive
| SORT time_bucket ASC
